title: SB2363 (2024 Regular): Responsible Firearm Purchasing Act; enact.

provenance.fetched_by: Open States bulk data (Mississippi) (gun-policy Stage 5, Mississippi); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official Mississippi text (Introduced; official copy, https://billstatus.ls.state.ms.us/documents/2024/html/SB/2300-2399/SB2363IN.htm)
provenance.note: Introduced text ('Responsible Firearm Purchasing Act'); no passage vote on file. Sections 5-6 as printed cite 'Section 2' (the definitions) and 'Section 2 or 3'; quoted as printed. Printed text reads 'no than' (word missing) in sections 5-6.

operative_text:
Section 3 (new section): It shall be unlawful for a minor in this state to purchase a firearm, handgun, ammunition or armor piercing ammunition. It shall be unlawful to sell a minor in this state a firearm, handgun, ammunition or armor piercing ammunition.
Section 4 (new section): The purchase of a firearm, handgun, ammunition or armor piercing ammunition shall comply with all standards as provided by federal and state law.
Section 5 (new section): A minor who violates this Section 2 of this act shall be guilty of a misdemeanor. Upon adjudication, the minor shall be fined no more than Two Hundred Dollars ($200.00) or subject to a term of imprisonment no than thirty (30) days, or both.
Section 6 (new section): A person who is twenty-one (21) years old and violates Section 2 or 3 of this act shall be guilty of a felony. Upon conviction, the defendant shall be fined no more than Two Thousand Dollars ($2,000.00) or subject to a term of imprisonment of no than two (2) years in the custody of the Department of Corrections, or both.
